skills.detail:
When the enemy has a Treasure Area:
Increases own SPD.
A long-range multiple hit attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage.
Transforms the nearest enemy Treasure Area into a Glorp-Glorp Treasure Area (up to 1 spot).
Glorp-Glorp Treasure Areas can unleash an area attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage and inflicts an ATK debuff.
The Glorp-Glorp transformation will disappear after you or an ally captures Treasure, after a certain amount of time passes, or after you are KO'd.

When the enemy has no Treasure Area:
Increases own SPD.
A long-range multiple hit attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage.

Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Cumulo-Glorpus

skills.detail:
A mid-range multiple hit attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage and inflicts a SPD debuff.
Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement.
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
Acquires HP recovery effect at Level 5.
